import re
from datetime import datetime
year=datetime.now().year
cable_year_files=sorted([p for p in res if '/bills/cable/' in p and f'/{year}-' in p and p.endswith('.txt')])
print('year',year)
print('files',cable_year_files)

def extract_total_amount(content):
    # look for 'Total Amount =>' then capture number possibly with $ and decimals
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

lines=[]
tot=0.0
for p in cable_year_files:
    fr=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=p)
    content=fr['content']
    amt=extract_total_amount(content)
    print('file',p,'amt',amt)
    tot+=amt
    lines.append((p,amt))
print('total',tot)
